ADMAPS_BROWSER.setup.title: Download & Setup
ADMAPS_BROWSER.setup.intro: Press {download} and select what you need{both}. Everything you select will come in a single ZIP file.
ADMAPS_BROWSER.setup.both: — the VTT files, the 4K files, or both
ADMAPS_BROWSER.setup.vtt1: The optimized files unpack into an {admaps} folder, with the scene JSON and props alongside whatever images and video you picked. Move this folder into your Foundry {data} folder so that {admaps} ends up next to {worlds} and {modules}.
ADMAPS_BROWSER.setup.vtt2: In Foundry, create a new scene and import the {json} file from the map's folder. The scene arrives fully set up with walls and props.
ADMAPS_BROWSER.setup.tv: The 4K files unpack into a {folder} folder. These are high-resolution maps (3840×2160px) meant for printing or digital table screens.
ADMAPS_BROWSER.systems: Works with {list} and any other grid-based TTRPG.
